story.heading: A fabricator, not a showroom chain
paragraphs: We build in West Chester. You can see how a door is made and how a finish is applied before you sign.
Bring the drawings or the messy kitchen photos. We will tell you what is worth changing.
MacLaren Kitchen and Bath serves people who live and work in West Chester.
You'll find the phone and the next step on this page, not buried in a menu.
Come in when you're ready. We'll make the visit straightforward.

feature.heading: The shop is the proof
feature.text: Catalog photos hide the joints. Come look at a real box, a real drawer, and a finish under shop lights.

spotlight.heading: 1135 Phoenixville Pike
spotlight.text: West Chester is home. Call so someone can pull samples for the visit.

contact.heading: Start in the shop
contact.sub: Phone and address are on this page. Bring measurements if you have them.
